risks: We derived 86.73%, 80.78%, 84.77% and 73.34% of our revenue from our top ten customers for the period ended June 30, 2026 and for the Fiscals 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
The loss of any of these customers or reduction in business from such will have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
We are dependent on limited number of customers for majority of our revenue from operations, which expose us to a high risk of customer concentration.
In the period ended on June 30, 2026, we have served total of 76 customers and in the Fiscal 2026, Fiscal 2025 and Fiscal 2024, we have served 76, 77 and 87 customers, respectively.

The table below sets forth our revenue from our Top One (1) customer, top three (3) customers, top five (5) customers and top ten (10) customers and their contribution to our revenue from operations for the periods indicated.
As of June 30, 2026, we had long-standing relationships of over Seven to Eight years with some of our top ten customers.

Given the concentration of our business among a limited number of customers, any loss of, or reduction in business from, one or more such customers may have a disproportionate and material adverse effect on our revenues, profitability, cash flows and liquidity.

Such loss or reduction may arise for several reasons, including termination or non-renewal of contracts, inability to agree on commercial terms, failure to meet performance or customisation requirements, technological changes, disputes, adverse changes in the financial condition or business priorities of customers (including insolvency or financial distress), reduced or delayed demand, operational disruptions at customer level, or sustained pricing pressures.

overview.business_overview:
Our Company, Carver Roboweld Limited (“CRL”), is engaged in the manufacturing of welding consumables, including Metal Cored Wires, Welding Rods and Gauging electrodes, catering to diverse industrial applications. Over the years, we have expanded our capabilities beyond manufacturing to offer a broad portfolio of value-added engineering services, as a solution provider to the forging industry. In addition to consumable manufacturing, the Company also supplies welding spare parts and accessories used for welding operations and maintenance of welding equipment. Further the Company provides services such as forging die regeneration and welding robot rental services.

Our primary manufacturing facility is located at Survey No. 98P, Near Gidc Bamanbore Estate Phase-1, Taluka Chotila, Bamanbore, Rajkot 363520, Gujarat, India., strategically positioned to support efficient production, logistics, and access to key industrial markets. To ensure proximity to customers and timely service delivery, the Company operates additional service units in Pune, Hosur, and Ludhiana, allowing us to serve major industrial companies across the country. The Company focuses on delivering engineered, solutions designed to meet the increasing requirements of modern industry. Our strength lies in a team of skilled engineers and technical professionals who bring expertise, innovation, and a customer-centric approach to every project. On September 26, 2025, our Company completed the acquisition of its subsidiary, Carver Engineering Private Limited, following a Share Sale and Transfer Agreement. This acquisition is expected to bring operational and strategic benefits, including market expansion by reaching new customer segments and regions, while improving the company’s competitive position. The integration of operations is also expected to create efficiencies, reduce costs, and provide economies of scale. Our subsidiary, Carver Engineering Private Limited, is engaged in the re-conditioning and refurbishment of plant and machinery serving a wide range of industrial sectors, including forging and casting units, cement and steel plants, sugar mills, power plants, petroleum facilities, automobile manufacturing units, and fabrication industries. Carver Engineering private limited offers comprehensive on-site and off-site engineering services, covering the re-conditioning and repair of hammers and associated components, heavy platform and structural fabrication, general and heavy-duty machining, and the execution of turnkey engineering projects. The subsidiary also undertakes assignments at offshore and remote locations, serving customers across diverse regions. Supported by technical expertise and engineering capabilities, the company also provides customized solutions tailored to specific customer needs. Its services are designed to be cost-effective, operationally efficient, and commercially viable, enabling customers to extend equipment life, enhance productivity, and reduce capital expenditure while ensuring timely and profitable project outcomes.

We are ISO 9001:2015 certified for sales of welding consumables, including welding electrodes and metal cored wires, as well as for the manufacturing and supply of welding electrodes. These certifications show our commitment to using quality management systems to maintain consistency, reliability, and customer satisfaction in all our processes. Additionally, we are a Sustaining Corporate Member of the American Welding Society (AWS). This membership highlights our commitment to following international welding standards, keeping up with technological advancements, and improving our technical skills.

We operate with an aggregate installed production capacity of 650 tons, computed on a yearly basis for Fiscal 2026, across Metal Cored Wires and Welding Rods operations, as of July 11, 2026. Our installed capacity has increased at a compound annual growth rate (“CAGR”) of approximately 30% between Fiscal 2025 and Fiscal 2026, reflecting our continued focus on capacity expansion and operational scalability. For further details see ‘Our Business – Installed Capacity and Capacity

Utilization’ on page 182

Our domestic customer base is spread across several states, including Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Punjab, Gujarat, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, West Bengal, Pondicherry and Telangana. Our top 10 customers accounted for revenue of ₹ 668.38 Lakhs, ₹ 2,182.72 Lakhs, ₹ 2,107.34 Lakhs, and ₹ 1,589.43 Lakhs for the period ended June 30, 2026 and for the financial years ended March 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively. These amounts represented 86.73%, 80.78%, 84.77%, and 73.34% of our total revenue from operations for the respective periods.

The raw materials used in the manufacturing of our products include Ferro Molybdenum, Cold Rolled Steel Strips, Ferro Tungsten Powder, Nickel Metal Powder, Chromium Metal Powder, Ferro Vanadium Powder, Iron Powder, and other raw materials. We procure the raw materials from both domestic and international markets, in the domestic market, these materials are sourced from Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Delhi, Madhya Pradesh, and Haryana. In addition to the domestic market, raw materials and welding robots accessories are also sourced from China, United States of America and Netherland. Our top 10 suppliers accounted for purchases of ₹ 306.96 Lakhs, ₹ 1,403.14 Lakhs, ₹ 1,197.64 Lakhs, and ₹ 933.79 Lakhs for the period ended June 30, 2026 and for the financial years ended March 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively. These amounts represented 90.82%, 92.43%, 94.26% and 87.15% of our total purchases for the respective periods.

Our Promoters, Ranjit Chandrabhai Bose, Rajit Chandra Bose, and Deval Ranjitbhai Bose, have collectively over 16 years of experience in the welding industry. Their background covers the manufacturing of welding consumables, robotic welding, process improvement, and market expansion.  Their leadership has helped the company grow in the welding sector by focusing on quality, innovation, and customer solutions. Their strategic vision and experience continue to guide the company in staying ahead of market trends, improving operations, and building strong financial and management practices for long-term growth.

For a detailed overview of our management team and our promoters, please refer to the chapters titled “Our Management” and “Our Promoter and Promoter Group” on pages 205 and 223 of this Red Herring Prospectus. We attribute our success to their sustained efforts in process improvements and expanding our operational scale. We believe that the combined experience and industry insight of our management team, along with their expertise in regulatory affairs, sales, marketing, and finance, position us to capitalize on both current and future market opportunities.
